responsibility: Implements `AST::TokenCollector`, a concrete AST visitor that traverses Rust AST nodes and reconstructs a token stream plus layout markers from them. It owns the per-node emission logic for tokens, comments, newlines, indentation, separators, and block formatting across items, expressions, statements, patterns, paths, macros, and types, so it serves as the AST-to-token collection layer used for reserialization and macro/token-oriented processing rather than human-readable dumping; where coverage is incomplete, it reports unimplemented visitor paths such as `FormatArgs`.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable visitor logic for `TokenCollector` declared in `rust-ast-collector.h`, defining how each AST node is turned into collected tokens, comments, newlines, and indentation markers; the header only defines the data structures and visitor surface.
